text: Quick Model Switch 是一款 DSH Web 插件，把输入框工具行的模型入口替换为供应商优先的双栏面板。它读取当前会话的模型目录，左侧展示供应商、收藏和最近切换，右侧显示对应模型；用户可搜索、切换模型与推理档位，并整理顺序、别名、收藏和最近记录。适合经常在多个已配置供应商和模型间切换的用户。面板偏好保存在浏览器 localStorage，模型选择通过 DSH 提供的目录服务完成。

Quick Model Switch replaces the DSH Web composer’s model picker with two panes for providers and their models. Search across providers, switch models, and manage favorites, recents, aliases, and ordering. Preferences are stored in browser localStorage; selection uses DSH’s model-directory service.
想在 DSH 输入框里更快地切换不同供应商的模型
能不能把常用模型收藏起来，切换时不用逐层找
我想按自己的习惯调整模型和供应商的显示顺序
需要一个能跨供应商搜索模型名称的选择面板
切换模型后能否自动记住最近用过的选项
I want to switch between configured model providers from the composer.
Can I search model names across providers in one picker?
I need a model picker that remembers favorites and recent choices.
模型目录双栏浏览：在输入框的模型入口打开面板，左侧选供应商或收藏、最近列表，右侧浏览模型。
搜索与切换模型：搜索框跨供应商匹配目录内容，选择模型后调用当前会话的目录服务；成功切换会加入最近列表。
管理模型偏好：用户可收藏模型、设置别名并调整供应商和模型顺序；偏好保存在浏览器 localStorage。
Quick Model Switch 将排序、别名、收藏、最近使用等面板偏好写入浏览器 localStorage 的 dsh.model-quick-switch.v1 项；模型目录和选择由 DSH Host 服务提供。

@aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch README · 它解决什么：供应商一多，官方那个分组下拉要一层层找。这个插件让**所有供应商在左侧一级菜单里直接可见**，
鼠标扫过就换右边的模型列表，点一下即切换。排序、别名、收藏、最近使用都按你自己的习惯来。
@aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch README · 安装：```powershell
@aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch README · 桌面端（profile 名为 desktop）：dsh plugin --profile desktop add @aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch

@aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch README · Web 端（profile 名为 web）：dsh plugin --profile web add @aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch
```

也可以在 GUI 的**插件市场**里搜 `dsh-model-quick-switch` 安装。

从源码安装（先 clone 到本地）：powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:C:/path/to/dsh-model-quick-switch
```

装好后刷新页面。输入框工具行原来的模型入口会变成这个双栏面板的入口。

@aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch README · 功能：- **双栏**：左列 = 收藏 / 最近 / 全部供应商（一级可见）；右列 = 该供应商的模型。
- **选中态**：已选模型与左侧当前供应商同一种高亮（实心底色 + 左侧品牌色竖条）；
  鼠标扫过只给临时底色，移开就只剩「当前选中」那一行亮着。
- **拖拽排序**：供应商顺序、每个供应商内的模型顺序、收藏顺序都能拖；
  键盘用户按 `Alt + ↑/↓` 移动当前行。
- **收藏**：点模型行右侧的星标，长期置顶在「收藏」里。
- **最近使用**：每次成功切换自动记录最近 12 个。
- **搜索**：顶部输入框按模型名 / 供应商名（含你起的别名）模糊匹配，跨供应商出结果。
- **模型右键菜单**：在右侧任一模型上右键即可重命名（别名，同样参与搜索）或收藏。
- **刷新供应商与模型**：从左侧供应商右键菜单触发，重新解析并加载**已配置好的供应商与模型**，
  新加的 key / 供应商不用重启应用。
- **删掉不用的供应商**：右键 →「从面板删除」把它从面板里移除（只影响面板，随时可恢复）。
- **推理强度**：选中模型后，行下方展开该模型适配器声明的档位，点一下即切档。
- **模型 badge**：目录自带的标签（如「新」）显示在模型名旁。
- **键盘**：`↑/↓` 移动、`Home/End` 首尾、`PageUp/PageDown` 翻页、`Enter` 选定、`Esc` 关闭。
- **失败可见**：某个供应商的目录加载失败时，它不会占用左栏供应商列表；错误状态仍保留在目录中，并可通过供应商刷新再次尝试。
- **不抢座位**：会话不可用时（例如子代理会话）主动留空，把位置交还官方席位。

@aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch README · 供应商右键菜单：在左侧任一供应商上右键（仅限真实供应商行，不含「收藏/最近」）：

| 菜单项 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| 重命名 | 就地改**本机显示别名**，回车保存、Esc 取消、留空恢复原名。别名会参与搜索，但不改底层 id、不影响调用 |
| 打开面板时默认选它 | 面板每次打开都停在这个供应商；再次点选可取消（右侧圆点标记当前默认） |
| 置顶 / 上移 / 下移 | 不拖拽也能排序，到达边界时自动置灰 |
| 重置该组模型顺序 | 只清掉这个供应商的模型顺序，不影响别组 |
| 全部加入收藏 / 清空该组收藏 | 批量把该供应商的模型收进「收藏」或全部移出 |
| 刷新供应商与模型 | 强制同步当前会话的最新配置；加完 key、供应商或模型后不用重启应用 |
| 从面板删除 | 该供应商从左栏、搜索、收藏、最近里一起消失；**只改本机面板**，profile 里的配置不动，左栏底部会留一行「已删除 N 个 · 恢复」 |

@aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch README · 模型右键菜单：在右侧任一模型上右键：

| 菜单项 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| 重命名 | 就地改**本机显示名**，回车保存、Esc 取消、留空恢复原名。别名参与搜索，不改底层模型 id |
| 恢复原名 | 起了别名才有意义，等价于把名字清空 |
| 收藏 / 取消收藏 | 与行右侧的星标同效 |

@aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch README · 数据与边界：- 选择走官方 `ctx.modelDirectories` 服务（同一个 `session.selectModel`），
  `/model` 弹窗与这里永远一致；Host 拒绝会以红字显示在面板底部。
- 顺序、别名（供应商与模型各一份）、默认供应商、收藏、最近、已删除的供应商都保存在
  **浏览器 localStorage**（`dsh.model-quick-switch.v1`），
  不写 profile 配置、不新增 Host 路由、不注册 locale 命名空间。
- 只替换 `conversation.input.model` 这一个可视席位。
- 「从面板删除」是**面板本地**操作：它只是让这个供应商在这一栏里不出现，
  profile 里的供应商配置原样保留，重新加载或换台机器都还在。
- 插件不联网、不上报、不读取任何密钥；它只读 Host 已经下发的模型目录。

@aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch README · 卸载：插件页禁用该 bundle，官方模型选择器立刻回来。收藏与排序数据要一并清掉的话，
删除浏览器的 `dsh.model-quick-switch.v1` 这一条 localStorage 即可。

A DSH Web client plugin that replaces the composer's **Model** menu with a
**provider-first, two-pane panel**.

*① A new session — the plugin takes over the Model seat in the composer's tool row*

@aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch README · Quick Model Switch：*② The panel expanded — every provider in the left rail, the selected provider's models on the right*

[中文说明](https://github.com/aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch/blob/main/README.md) · [Changelog](https://github.com/aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) · [Contributing](https://github.com/aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)

@aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch README · Why：The shipped picker groups models behind a nested dropdown. Once you have a few
providers, switching means walking down through levels. This plugin puts **every
provider in the left rail, one level deep**: hover a provider to swap the model
list on the right, click a model to switch. Ordering, aliases, pins and recents
are all yours to arrange.
@aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch README · Install：```powershell
@aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch README · desktop app (profile named "desktop")：dsh plugin --profile desktop add @aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch

@aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch README · web profile：dsh plugin --profile web add @aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch
```

Or search for `dsh-model-quick-switch` in the in-app **plugin market**.

From source (clone it first):powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:C:/path/to/dsh-model-quick-switch
```

Reload the page afterwards. The model entry in the composer toolbar becomes this
panel's trigger.

@aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch README · Features：- **Two panes** — left: pins / recents / every provider; right: that provider's models.
- **Clear current state** — the selected model and its provider in the rail share the
  same highlight (filled background plus a brand-coloured bar on the left). Hovering
  only tints a row temporarily; move away and just the current selection stays lit.
- **Drag to reorder** — provider order, model order inside each provider, and pin
  order. Keyboard users can move the focused row with `Alt + ↑/↓`.
- **Pins** — the star on any model row keeps it at the top under **Pinned**.
- **Recents** — the last 12 successful switches, recorded automatically.
- **Search** — fuzzy match on model name, provider name and your aliases, across providers.
- **Model context menu** — right-click any model to rename it (a local alias that also
  participates in search) or pin it.
- **Reload** — the ↻ button in the list header re-resolves and reloads the providers
  and models **you already configured**, so a new key or provider needs no app restart.
- **Drop providers you do not use** — right-click → **Delete from this panel** removes it
  from the panel only,
@aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch README · Provider context menu：Right-click any provider in the left rail (real providers only, not Pins/Recents):

@aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch README · Provider context menu：| Item | Effect |
|---|---|
| Rename | Edit a **local display alias** in place: `Enter` saves, `Esc` cancels, empty restores the original. Aliases participate in search but never change the underlying id or the request. |
| Open the panel on this provider | Makes it the provider the panel lands on next time; click again to clear (the dot on the right marks the default). |
| Pin to top / Move up / Move down | Reorder without dragging; items grey out at the boundaries. |
| Reset this group's model order | Clears the model order of that provider only. |
| Pin all / Clear this group's pins | Bulk add or remove that provider's models from **Pinned**. |
| Reload model catalog | Pick up new models or keys without reloading the page. |
| Delete from this panel | Removes the provider from the rail, search, pins and recents. **Panel-local only** — your profile configuration is untouched, and a `N removed · Restore` row stays at the bottom of the rail. |

@aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch README · Model context menu：Right-click any model in the right pane:

| Item | Effect |
|---|---|
| Rename | Edit a **local display name** in place: `Enter` saves, `Esc` cancels, empty restores the original. Aliases participate in search but never change the model id. |
| Reset to catalog name | Only meaningful once an alias exists; it clears it. |
| Pin / Unpin | Same as the star on the row. |

@aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch README · Data and boundaries：- Selection goes through the shipped `ctx.modelDirectories` service (the same
  `session.selectModel`), so the `/model` popup and this panel can never disagree;
  a Host rejection is shown in red at the bottom of the panel.
- Order, aliases (one set for providers, one for models), the default provider, pins,
  recents and deleted providers live in **browser localStorage** under
  `dsh.model-quick-switch.v1`. The plugin writes no profile configuration, adds no Host
  route and registers no locale namespace.
- It replaces exactly one visual seat: `conversation.input.model`.
- **Delete from this panel** is panel-local: it hides the provider in this panel only.
  The provider configuration in your profile stays exactly as it is.
- No network access, no telemetry, no credential access. It only reads the model
  catalog the Host already publishes.

@aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch README · Uninstall：Disable the bundle on the plugins page and the shipped selector returns immediately.
To drop its data too, delete the `dsh.model-quick-switch.v1` localStorage entry.

There is no build step: the profile loads `client.js` directly, so a page reload
picks up your edits.

@aichixiaojuzi/dsh-model-quick-switch README · Known limitations：- If a pinned model disappears from the catalog its key is kept, and it returns to
  Pinned when the model comes back.
- The trigger keeps showing the model name on narrow widths (truncated) rather than
  collapsing to an icon.
- Rename is display-only, for providers and models alike; catalog names come from the
  Host and are never rewritten.
- The model catalog is cached by the Host, so models added after the page loaded only
  appear once the Host refreshes; the ↻ button forces a re-resolve, but a provider the
  Host itself rejects still surfaces as an error.
